$comment: Printed phrases that name different places in different eulogies: resolved per eulogy, keyed '<phrase>@<eulogy ID>' (scripts/build_gazetteer.py split). The reason says which places.
ecclésiam Sancti Petri: St Peter's in Rome (mr:0406-galla-romae) and San Pietro in Perugia (mr:0710-petrus-vincioli)
monastérium Sanctæ Crucis: Holy Cross at Poitiers (mr:0513-agnes-pictavii) and La Croix-Saint-Leufroy (mr:0621-leutfridus-ebroicensis)
Bonóniæ: Bononia in Moesia, Vidin (mr:0104-hermes-et-caius), and Bologna (mr:0808-dominicus-bononiae)
Británniæ: Great Britain (Gildas, mr:0129-gilda-sapiens) and Brittany (Charles of Blois, Françoise d'Amboise)
Lotharíngia: Lorraine (Jean-Martin Moÿe, mr:0504-ioannes-martinus-moye, 18th century) and medieval Lotharingia (Gerard, mr:1003-gerardus-broniensis)
Dumiénsis: Mondoñedo (Rudesind, mr:0301-rudesindus-dumiensis) and Dume near Braga (Fructuosus, mr:0416-fructuosus-dumiensis)
Northúmbriæ: the Kingdom of Northumbria (Etheldreda, Oswald, Paulinus) and Northumberland (Thomas Percy, mr:0822-thomas-percy)
Constantinopolitánum: the Third Council of Constantinople (Leo II, mr:0703-leo-ii) and the see of Constantinople (Silverius, mr:1202-silverius-papa)
